title: Carry-Over Allowance on the Community Rules & Site Care Statement
content:
A carry-over allowance may stay on the Community Rules & Site Care statement by tenure, counted in whole calendar months from the move-in date on the Home-Site Lease to the handling date:

- with at least 180 months of tenure, the allowance is $10.00;
- with at least 60 months but fewer than 180 months, the allowance is $5.00;
- with fewer than 60 months, there is no allowance.

The allowance is subtracted from the past-due amount, and what remains once every amount allowed to stay on the statement has been subtracted is never less than zero.

## Both sides of each threshold

| Tenure (whole calendar months) | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 59 | none |
| 60 | $5.00 |
| 179 | $5.00 |
| 180 | $10.00 |

## Hypothetical cases

- A past-due amount of $59.00 and 75 months of tenure: $5.00 stays on the statement and $54.00 remains.
- A past-due amount of $3.00 and 75 months of tenure: the remainder would fall below zero, so it is $0.00.
